title: Zesty Buttery Russian Grape Leaf Dolmas
description: Buttery, fluffy, and adventurous Russian dish featuring grape leaves, dashi extract, and vegan friendly ingredients, cooked in a copper pot.
instructions: Rinse the grape leaves and remove the stems.
In a large copper pot, combine the melted vegan butter, dashi extract, and lemon juice.
Add the flour, nutritional yeast, salt, and black pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Lay a grape leaf flat on a work surface, with the stem end facing you.
Place about 1 tablespoon of the flour mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the stem end over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a neat package.
Repeat with the remaining grape leaves and filling.
Place the dolmas in the copper pot, seam side down, and cook over medium heat for 20 minutes.
Serve the dolmas hot, garnished with lemon wedges.
